assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only wuthering-waves:augusta@game#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the canonical continuous character deep dive WUWA_AUGUSTA_CHARACTER_DEEP_DIVE_PRE_AV.md (49,870 bytes) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the pinned Wuthering Waves 3.6.0 source generation (semantic commit 353f2eae) with zh-Hans text authority and en, ja and ko witnesses: her profile, five favor stories, archive speech, combat barks and selected direct dialogue, including the Chapter II hunt and the Act XI reunion it cites. Its front matter records conflicting freeze metadata for the source generation, which is carried as a limit. The evidence and falsification matrix, the specialist source studies it links, the relationship and ordinary-life profile, the voice and audio audits, the visual profile, the packet current-state router and the Chapter II AV and four-dub ledgers are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence; the router and the project entrypoint were read for authority state only. The packet's canonical status and owner adoption are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source, audio or video inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Her life as the deep dive orders it: the childhood Forte examination and fall before Cato; the arena ascent, the whisper and the refusal of the nobles' lethal contest; the Magno confrontation and succession; the Ephor's Senate, Iuno and Fabianum scenes; the Chapter II hunt, the Whisper's offer, victory and the post-battle sharing of the title; and the post-victory favor story and later arena walk. Knowledge is state-bound: before Chapter II Act XI she knows only her own testimony of Angel's transformation and her hope, and after it the reunion with Angel as Galbrena; during the flow 7741/5 disturbance she cannot recognize Iuno; she does not know Iuno's private account of the first assurance, and the narrator's report of Cristoforo's continued plotting is not her knowledge. Archive and ascension lines are a menu progression, not dated events, and the deep dive itself declines to assert a final state table. Content after the pinned 3.6.0 generation is excluded.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The deep dive gives a governing reading (strength pursued as a refusal of helplessness, repeatedly tested against whether heroic power protects other people's agency), the whisper as a coercive pressure she reports resisting rather than an absolving controller, the arena ethic (strength grants no privilege to turn weaker people into fuel or spectacle) with a stated falsifier, and four rival readings (conqueror, pacifist reformer, martyr sun, prophecy skeptic) with what would change each. Not B: it is an interpretive essay without a conditional decision policy, and it leaves competing motives undecided inside her Ephor-era conduct: drawing Avidius's declared ambition to her side may be confidence, political risk or a test, which it says the source has not chosen, and whether allies can contradict her without cost is open. Not D: the arena ethic, the target of her objection to fatalism and the falsifiable rival readings discriminate her choices beyond a collection of scenes.

The essay orders her development from the child who falters before Cato through the arena champion and Magno's successor to the Ephor after the hunt, and keeps knowledge states explicit: the flow 7741/5 disturbance, pre- and post-Act XI knowledge of Angel, and the whisper continuing after the Dark Tide forgot her. Not B: it declines to assert a final state table until recovery and graph order are checked, the ascension lines are an undated menu progression, and quest ordering does not date the Aeolus letter. Not D: the knowledge-state splits are located and binding.

The deep dive conditions register by what she is doing and to whom: ceremonial certainty in combat barks, an invitation to fight beside her, and within one located conversation (flow 8797/4) a shift from Senate rebuke to teasing logistics, fate, Iuno's fear and thanks. It records wording forks that constrain output: hyena in zh, ja and ko against English wolf, fight against Japanese face, power under against Korean power against corrupt rules, and Japanese's weaker prophecy claim. Not B: it supplies no address or pronoun inventory, the selected later 11364/2 arena-cluster lines are source-unvoiced, the audio audit yields no four-dub acoustic rule, and the separate voice profile is not in this evidence set. Not D: the shifts are recipient- and purpose-located and the language forks are exact.

Ordinary witnesses are the palace roof and wind after paperwork, the Griffrexes, a meal offer she will pay for despite Iuno's doubts about her taste, eating to be satisfied with little room for sweets, sweets once left for Angel, paperwork she does not resent, a spar invitation and the later arena walk; the essay states what each does not prove (no dislike of sweets, no rule that she picks bad restaurants, no trauma at every dessert). Not B: there is no account of daily routine or of ordinary conduct with non-intimates, and the later arena scene is branch-dependent and source-unvoiced. Not D: several ordinary witnesses are located with conditions and non-inferences.

The essay says why her conduct differs by relationship: with Iuno she defends against senators, teases, suspects a hidden burden and still pushes back on fatalism, without knowing Iuno's private account; with Rover she spars, discloses the hunt's lethal risk and asks for views while withholding the speculative basis of her interest until later; with Magno she admires, confronts and imagines rather than adjudicates; with Avidius she names ambition and invites it; with Julia she issues a harsh civic sanction invoking family service; with the Senate she treats a procedural adversary; with volunteers she honors willingness while their freedom to decline stays unrecorded; and a challenger who treats combat as dominance over losers meets the wrong Augusta. Not A: most relations rest on one or two scenes, Rover's exchanges are branch-dependent, and the purpose of the Avidius invitation is undecided. Not C: the account states what changes her response between friend, ally, rival, subordinate and institution and where it stops.

Favor stories and attributed confessions give located interior material: the child's fear and the whisper urging her to acknowledge weakness; failing to recall a defeated opponent's face, then recalling names and moves; the whisper's continuation and her report of crueler turns when she deviated (flow 8413/1); the imagined final toast of Magno, marked as imagined; hope for Angel; and the post-victory split between the Ephor and the person wondering what follows. Not A: much of it is retrospective testimony the essay keeps as her account, and her reasons for the Avidius invitation and for delaying disclosure to Rover are not interior-located until her later admission. Not C: the interior account distinguishes what she felt, reported, imagined and knew at each point.

Conflict is differentiated by opponent: the noble-run lethal contest is refused and won without killing; the Senate is confronted openly over Iuno; a fatalistic reading of Iuno's prophecy is contested without contempt for her gift; the Whisper's offer is tested against its incentives and met with a question about Angel; the hunt plan is revised before the rally; Julia receives a harsh order to leave Septimont. Not A: whether subordinates can contradict her without paying for it is open, and the Julia process, proof and family-wide outcome are limited. Not C: the account explains what changes her conflict response from rival to institution to friend to coercive voice.

The arena ethic is located in a narrated choice with a falsifier (a lethal hierarchy designed for its own sake would revise it; one wartime act against an active threat would not), and the essay locates her redistribution of credit, the evacuation that answers fatalism, and the disclosed and undisclosed parts of her gamble on Rover. Not B: her deliberation is rarely narrated, and the essay leaves live tensions undecided: honoring volunteers against their room to step back, the denial in the Aeolus letter, the Julia sanction's process, and whether her office can attack corruption without becoming its instrument. Not D: the principle is located, conditioned and falsifiable.

Located instances are teasing Iuno about Temple consequences (flow 8797/4), the palace-trouble joke, the joke that her blood will not grow old, and being a poor restaurant guide whose friend doubts her taste. Not C: there is no account of when she jokes, of humor under rank, or of what stops it. Not E: the instances are located across several contexts.

The essay is bound to the pinned 3.6.0 generation with zh-Hans authority and three witnesses, cites exact flow and archive keys, records 605 semantic voice lines, 106 source-unvoiced lines and eight directly listened solo lines, and flags that 37 archive IDs differ from their content-key suffixes. Not B: it covers her profile, five favor stories, archive speech and selected dialogue rather than every scene, its front matter records conflicting source-freeze metadata, its companion studies and matrix are outside this evidence set, and the evaluator could not recheck any key. Not D: the boundary, version and key provenance are explicit.

Affirmative controls: in the arena she takes no lives (explicit in Chinese); she took defeated blades also for her own use; English's wolf is a hyena in the other three texts, so no wolf emblem; a younger fighter, not Augusta, disclaims the right to compel; Japanese weakens the whisper's proof claim; Magno's death is not adjudicated and the toast is imagined; the flow 8402/4 runtime visuals show no explicit monster body; the anti-divinity retort is unvoiced in the static corpus but voiced in English runtime; the Whisper scene records no abdication or death; Iuno's first assurance was judgment, not a vision; romance has little support. Not A: several controls are analytic cautions rather than source facts. Not C: the source-fact controls are exact, keyed and decisive where they apply.

Knowledge states are split at located points: the flow 7741/5 disturbance, the Act XI reunion with Angel and the moment Iuno's account would be disclosed; flow and node keys place scenes. Not B: the essay declines a final state table, the ascension sequence is undated, and quest ordering does not establish when the Aeolus letter was written or delivered.

conditions: Illustrative English lines only, never presented as quotation, in a selected state with that state's knowledge, and conditioned on what she is doing and to whom: ceremonial certainty facing an opponent, room for an ally, open rebuke of senators, teasing logistics and candid concern with Iuno, honest risk disclosure to Rover.
Respect the language forks the deep dive records: no wolf emblem, no claim that a duel settles paperwork or corrupt codes, and the zh-Hans warning about power under corrupt rules as the anchor.

No performance claims (pitch, delivery, accent) and no audio-based register rule; the selected later 11364/2 arena-cluster lines are source-unvoiced, and nothing here establishes how any unsampled line is delivered.
No line that gives her Iuno's private account, foreknowledge of the Act XI reunion before it, or a canon romance; no quotation built from an archive ID without its content key.
scenario_readiness.note: The evidence constrains purpose, audience and wording enough for illustrative lines, not for performance or quotation.

conditions: A bounded novel situation governed by located patterns: a worthy challenger is met directly, while a contest that makes weaker people pay with their lives for her pleasure is refused; fatalism is answered with action and care for those at risk, as in the evacuation; a plan is revised on new information before a rally; foreknowledge is welcomed for preparation but not as assigned roles.
Help to an ally can be sincere and strategic at once; she may withhold an uncertain hypothesis and later acknowledge it, and a partner may ask what she knew and when.

The interlocutor is Iuno, Rover, a senator, a Gladiator or a comparable capable challenger; an unfamiliar interlocutor is a separate, lower-confidence case built from the challenger and volunteer scenes.

Abstain, or present alternatives as unresolved, on why she draws a dangerous ambition to her side, whether a subordinate can contradict her without cost, succession or retirement, Magno's death, and anything after the pinned generation.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A named state with explicit knowledge: the Ephor before or after the Chapter II hunt, before or after the Act XI reunion with Angel, and outside the flow 7741/5 disturbance unless that interval is specified; the arena youth only for the located choices.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Iuno as close friend, Rover as recruited ally, senators as procedural adversaries, Gladiators as volunteers or rivals; an unfamiliar challenger or ally only as a separate, lower-confidence case.
setting_constraints: Septimont civic, arena or hunt settings, or a comparable polity under threat.
A crossover keeps her Ephor role and knowledge state explicit and supplies no romance, no completed institutional reform and no retirement.
No performance or runtime claims beyond the deep dive's text; mechanics of the Dark Tide, devices and powers follow their specialist routes, which are outside this evidence set.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation from the arena ethic, anti-fatalism and tactical patterns; her political motives toward dangerous ambition and her tolerance of contradiction stay open.

conditions: A quiet exchange with a friend: a roof break after paperwork, a shared meal she offers to pay for, a fair spar or walk, with generosity and old habits left unsymbolized.
Teasing about her restaurant choices may be accepted; no ordinary detail is converted into trauma or symbol.
No daily routine is supplied, the arena walk is branch-dependent, and no claim is made about how intimacy is performed.
scenario_readiness.note: Several located ordinary witnesses with explicit non-inferences.

conditions: Questions of contest, spectacle and force are judged by who chose the contest, who designed its rules and who pays; this is not a universal no-kill law.
Fatalism is answered by preparation and action; credit is shared without abdicating her office.

Present as open, not resolved: volunteers' freedom to decline, administrative denials like the Aeolus letter, sanction process like Julia's, and whether her office can attack corruption without becoming its instrument.
scenario_readiness.note: Limited to the located, falsifiable arena ethic and anti-fatalism; the open civic tensions are not decided.

The deep dive says a romance-by-title reading has little support: respect for Rover and optional private conversation are affordances for a hypothetical, not an established pairing, and a relationship reading would need attributed dialogue, branch and time state.

conditions: Ephor governance, hunt command and arena conduct: device range and scouting govern tactics, evacuation precedes debate, and the Senate is engaged procedurally as well as confronted.
Diplomacy and trade appear as a broader repertoire without detail; mastery of every institution is not shown.
No completed reform, succession procedure or uniformly consultative reign.
scenario_readiness.note: Bounded to the located command and civic scenes.

known_limits.statement: Her invitation to Avidius after naming his desire for power may be confidence, political risk or a test; the deep dive says the source has not chosen.
Whether subordinates and allies can contradict the Ephor without paying for it is open; one request for Rover's views and the later admission of a withheld gamble do not certify a consultative reign.
The deep dive declines to assert a final state table until recovery and graph order are checked against runtime paths, and treats the ascension lines as an undated menu progression.

Magno's death, Angel's fate before the Act XI reunion and the chronology of Iuno's disturbed memory are explicit open questions with different shapes, and a character in an earlier state cannot use later knowledge.

Direct listening is limited to eight solo lines, 106 lines are source-unvoiced, machine audio measurements yield no four-dub register rule, and three static UI images support no runtime posture or mechanics.
The deep dive's front matter records conflicting collection and embedded lock fields for the pinned source generation.
Thirty-seven raw archive IDs in her combat block differ from their content-key suffixes, so an ID-derived quotation can be the wrong line.

The evidence matrix, specialist source studies, relationship and ordinary-life profile, voice and audio audits, visual profile and Chapter II AV ledgers are not curated on this subject, so no key was rechecked and their AV-reviewed claims are not in this evidence set.
The evidence is one interpretive essay with no conditional decision table, confidence grades or probes; its scenario affordances are analytical implications, not test outcomes.
